EN.name: Sensor
EN.definition: A sensor is a device that measures a physical quantity and converts it into a signal which can be read by an observer or by an instrument.

EN.name: Flow Instrument
EN.definition: A flow instrument reads and displays the value of a particular property of a system at a point, or displays the difference in the value of a property between two points.
